claims: As of April 2026, the Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" (ref. 126710BLRO in steel and 126719BLRO in white gold) has reportedly been discontinued.
The modern ceramic model of the Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" ended a 12-year run.
Removal from authorized dealer websites provides evidence of the Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" discontinuation.
Reports state that no further stock of the Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" is being shipped.
Both the stainless steel (on Jubilee or Oyster bracelets) and white gold (blue/meteorite dials) Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" models are affected.
Rolex rarely makes official "discontinued" press releases.
The Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" discontinuation was heavily rumored since February 2026.
Retailers, including Bucherer, began removing the Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" model from their listings in February 2026.
Secondary market prices for the Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" approach $30,000.
Some dealers list the Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" over $50,000 due to supply scarcity.
The Rolex GMT-Master II "Pepsi" discontinuation is part of the 2026 Watches & Wonders announcements.
